meta.title: Buyer applies AI Smart Grouping to the PR table

plan.title: Apply AI Smart Grouping to PR Table

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions page where the PR table and Smart Grouping control are available.

args.goal: On the Purchase Requisitions page, click the Smart Grouping button above the PR table, choose a recommended prompt such as Group by product category in the Procol AI side panel, click the blue send icon, wait for the AI response, click Apply Grouping, and stop when the PR table visibly shows new Smart Groups.

steps.note: Perform the AI side-panel workflow and apply the returned grouping because no dedicated catalog step exposes these controls.
Verify that applying the grouping updated the PR table with Smart Groups.
